description: React component for rendering various types of dialog elements (text, textarea, select, bool, radio) in Mattermost's interactive dialogs, including handling of autocomplete suggestions and settings.

classes.name: DialogElement
classes.description: React component class for dialog elements with support for various input types and autocomplete suggestions.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the component, sets up providers based on props, and default value.

methods.name: handleSelected
methods.description: Handles selection from autocomplete options, updates state and triggers onChange.

methods.name: render
methods.description: Renders the appropriate input element based on the 'type' prop, including text, select, bool, and radio inputs.
